description: Validates and normalizes a 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 collateral manifest digest and derives its deterministic specialty-title registry commitment ID (cmt_*) for fine art, bullion, manuscripts, or collectibles. Use when: confirming manifest SHA-256 digest conformance and commitment binding prior to paid underwriting. Do not use when: checking unhashed JSON manifest fields (use inspect_manifest_schema instead) or verifying a signed ZK_PROV_V1 certificate (use verify_zk_provenance_proof instead). Behavior: Read-only, stateless, deterministic computation (p99=42ms; free discovery tier at 30 RPM without billing).

asset_sha256.description: 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the canonical collateral manifest JSON, with optional 0x prefix (e.g., "0x9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08").

collateral_class.description: Specialty collateral classification bound into the cmt_* registry commitment ID (default: "fine_art").

name: verify_asset_hash

locked_production_fields.description: Gated attestation fields unlocked via generate_zk_provenance_proof.

registry_commitment_id.description: Deterministic specialty-title commitment identifier prefixed with cmt_.

schema_conformance_valid.description: True when the digest conforms to ANX-RFC-001 32-byte SHA-256 rules.

title: Collateral SHA-256 Digest & Commitment Verifier
